aiVerification.summary: Draft has citeable evidence but the changed-factor and baseline grouping are too ambiguous for final use.
issues: Distinct test conditions are bundled into one changed factor.
Normal baseline is inconsistent; row 31 is omitted despite high NG.
Semi-frame move trials may be separate follow-up tests, not same factor as new lot material.
Tension outcome lacks spec value and clear A/B grouping.
Header-only measurement-2 duplicates defect data and is not a valid measurement outcome.
requiredUserQuestions: Should row 25 or row 31 be the valid normal baseline for vision NG comparison?
Are the semi-frame E2/C2 move trials separate experiments or part of the same new-lot material review?
correctionPlan: Split or clearly label new lot material, semi-frame E2 to C2, and C2 to E2 conditions.
Include row 31 in baseline/test interpretation or justify exclusion.
Rebuild vision comparisons only against the correct normal baseline.
Add 0.03 kgf spec to tension results and group Suspension A/B by carried-down Type.
Remove measurement-2 or convert it into defect-count subresults with data-row citations.
aiVerification.evidencePolicy: Row citations exist, but grouping citations are insufficient until baseline and condition mapping are corrected.
